disqualifier.note: Independent MCP tool annotation axes (destructive vs read-only) plus a derived policy-approval predicate; read-only+non-destructive, destructive+approved, and other free combinations are all legal audit paths.

Independent coherence predicates over one VerifiedSpanAttemptRecord: re-anchor link integrity, failure-stage candidate indexing, and source authorization can each fail alone; validators AND them as free checks, not exclusive phases.

Independent SVG accessibility name sources: aria-labelledby/describedby text association vs aria-label; hasAccessibleName ORs aria-label with labelledby, and both-false is the ordinary unnamed diagram case.

Independent CSS calc tokenization facts while parsing a source-size sum: operator presence and surrounding whitespace can each be true or false; spaced-product parsing requires both spaces but operator-less and unspaced combos remain legal parse outcomes.
Independent integrity checks over conformance annotation payloads: unique source/invariant ids vs profile relative-reference integrity; either can fail without the other.

Independent CSSOM safety predicates for Mermaid-injected stylesheets: per-rule unsafe detection, selector-root confinement, and whole-sheet acceptance; unsafe and safe rules can coexist and the sheet predicate aggregates free combinations.
